## Profile Summary
Yeray Garrido is a Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer based in Bilbao, Basque Country (Spain). He specializes in PHP, Java, custom WordPress development, robust backend systems, and high-performance web applications.

- Languages: PHP, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
- Technologies: WordPress, React, Next.js, Node.js, Vercel, MySQL
- Key Focus: Backend Architecture, Custom Plugin Development, API Integrations, Web Performance
